libreria.note: en_meaning completed with the second everyday sense 'bookcase'.

eventuale.note: kind partial -> full: eventuale never means 'eventual/final' in any dictionary sense (and the author marks eventualmente full).

camera.note: kind full -> partial: monolingual dictionaries list camera as 'macchina da presa / telecamera' in film and TV usage; only the still-photo sense is absent.

stanza.note: kind full -> partial: stanza is also the metrical term (strofa of a canzone, ottava) in Italian dictionaries.

avvenimento.note: Not a real false friend: avvenimento does not resemble 'adventure' closely enough for learners to confuse them; no teacher-attested trap.

cappello.note: Not a real false friend: cappello/chapel is not a confusion English speakers make; cappello vs cappella is an Italian-internal minimal pair.

disgrazia.note: kind full -> partial: 'cadere in disgrazia' = fall into disgrace/out of favour is a listed sense; en_meaning widened to include 'accident'.

comprensivo.note: en_meaning completed with the very frequent 'comprensivo di' = inclusive of; kind left full.

agenda.note: kind full -> partial: dictionaries list the extended sense 'list of items to deal with, programme' (agenda politica, agenda dei lavori).

evidenza.note: kind full -> partial: 'evidenze scientifiche', 'medicina basata sull'evidenza' are current and recorded; the shared sense exists, though prova remains the normal word.

prevenire.note: Meanings too close: 'prevenire' does mean 'prevent' in its main use (prevenire le malattie); the given en_meaning 'anticipate, forestall' would teach learners that 'prevent' is wrong.

rapporto.note: Meanings too close: 'un buon rapporto' is the normal rendering of 'a good rapport', so the mistake does no harm; not a trap.
